issues.issue: Whether the RPD properly rejected the appellant's claim for lack of credibility
issues.applicant_position: RPD failed to properly assess his credibility; he cannot be blamed for third-party writings made in his absence.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_text: RAD finds the appellant not credible and agrees with the RPD's credibility findings.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in giving no weight to the Egyptian documents
issues.applicant_position: RPD wrongly rejected Egyptian documents, lacked expertise on foreign documents and ignored the presumption of truthfulness.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not intervene on appeal.
issues.result_text: RPD gave the documents no weight after weighing testimony; it did not rule them forged, and RAD agrees.
